caption: Aerial photograph of the Burghölzli psychiatric clinic, Zürich, 1949.
alt: Black-and-white aerial photograph of a large institutional building complex surrounded by trees, gardens, and fields on a hillside above Zürich.
credit: Wikimedia Commons / ETH-Bibliothek Zürich, Bildarchiv, photograph by Swissair (Comet AG), "Zürich, Burghölzli", LBS_H1-012468, 4 July 1949
note: Stoll's article is not digitized anywhere reachable (see draft.textSource); no full text or page image was found, and no portrait of Werner A. Stoll himself could be located. Stoll ran the 1947 LSD trial as an assistant physician at the Burghölzli, the Zürich psychiatric university clinic (not at his father Arthur Stoll's Sandoz laboratory), on doctors and patients there; this is a photograph of that clinic, taken two years after the study, as an honest contextual image of the actual setting rather than a substitute portrait. Deliberately not a photograph of Albert Hofmann. Kept despite the CC BY-SA licence: the photograph is used unmodified and attributed, which the licence permits. Attribution renders in the source note.
